T, FINIS and Ford numbers: one part, several numbers

EKS LKW · 06.11.2026

An old invoice says T199352, the part itself says CC46 2L324 AA. It is the same valve. This happens a lot and causes confusion when ordering.

Where the different numbers come from

The Ford number (such as CC46 2L324 AA) is the design number marked on the part. Alongside it, distribution catalogues, packaging labels and invoices use other numbers: short numbers starting with T, such as T199352, or numeric 7-digit FINIS numbers. They do not replace the Ford number; they accompany it in ordering systems.

How we link them in the catalogue

When the link between a T or FINIS number and a Ford number is documented, we show both on the same part page, under “Referințe asociate” (related references). A few examples from the catalogue:

  • CC46 2L324 AA = T199352 — parking brake circuit relay valve
  • 7C46 7550 BA = T165054 — clutch disc, 430 mm
  • AC46 7K626 AA = T190733 — clutch slave cylinder

You can search any of them in the search; the result leads to the same page.

When there is no link

For some T numbers we do not have a matching Ford number yet. Their pages show only the number and the name. That does not mean the part cannot be found; it just has to be checked separately. Send us the number and, if possible, a photo of the part or its packaging.

What not to do

Don't assume two numbers are equivalent just because the digits look alike. T199352 and T199353 can be completely different parts. We establish equivalence from documents, not from similar-looking numbers.
